root_cause: Public Portal V2 opened with AI-oriented tool labels, disconnected dashboard metrics and static example progress, financial gains and customer activities that were visible before customer context had been verified.
prevention_rule: One top-level customer journey connects source -> impact -> decision -> accountable action -> verified result using existing Portal V2 registered pages. Do not create a second navigation, AI platform or data source. Only explicit demo tenant may see sample static figures with visible demo notice; real customer profile data is marked indicative and actual outcomes require evidence.
